payload.summary: Search header interface is very wide: MasterSearchHeader takes about 61 props and its two callers pass 56 and 40
payload.detail: src/components/clinical-dashboard/master-search-header.tsx:184 (about 3,140 lines) is fed by src/components/ClinicalDashboard.tsx:3216 (56 props) and src/components/clinical-dashboard/global-search-shell.tsx:942 (40 props), so any search behaviour change touches three large files. The ClinicalDashboard size itself (4,057 lines, 57 useState) is already tracked as a monolith in docs/maturity-backlog-workorders.md section X3; this row is only the header interface. Next action: design a deeper search-session module (codebase-design vocabulary) that owns query, mode and filter state behind a small interface. Protected surface: search chrome rules in AGENTS.md apply, needs docs/search-chrome-behaviour.md and npm run verify:phone-chrome. Planned work, not a quick fix.
